recipe_version.title: Cuban Sandwiches with Mojo Pork Tenderloin, Ham, Swiss, and Pickles
recipe_version.description: Pork tenderloin marinated in garlicky citrus mojo and roasted, then sliced and layered on Cuban bread with ham, Swiss cheese, dill pickles, and yellow mustard. Pressed in a buttered skillet under a heavy pan until crisp and melty.

ingredients.name: Cuban bread
ingredients.display_name: large Cuban bread whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, sugar, and lard or oil only

ingredients.name: thinly sliced deli ham
ingredients.display_name: thinly sliced ham whose label lists pork, water, salt, sugar, and curing agents only

ingredients.name: dill pickle sandwich slices
ingredients.display_name: dill pickle sandwich slices whose label lists cucumbers, vinegar, salt, and dill

steps.title: Marinate the pork
steps.body: Whisk the orange juice, lime juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, olive oil, and salt. Coat the pork in the mojo in a bowl.

steps.title: Preheat and marinate
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F. The pork marinates while the oven heats fully, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Set the pork on a rimmed sheet pan, pour over a little of the mojo, and roast until it reads 145 F, about 22 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thin.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Cut the bread into 4 lengths and split each. Spread mustard on both cut sides. Layer Swiss, ham, sliced pork, pickles, and more Swiss, and close. Butter the outsides.

steps.title: Press
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch skillet over medium-low. Press 2 sandwiches at a time under a heavy skillet, about 4 minutes per side, until flattened, deep golden, and the cheese melts.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut each sandwich on the diagonal and serve hot.

equipment: heavy skillet or foil-wrapped brick for pressing
